messages:
sarah: Hey team — I transitioned from contractor to FT with start date 4/1 and enrolled in benefits 4/2. I just received an invoice from the contractor plan for April premiums. Do I have to pay this or can it be reversed?

 sophia (People Ops): Hi @sarah — sorry for the hassle. Typically coverage isnt retroactive before your FT effective date, and if you were enrolled in FT on 4/1 we ask the vendor to cancel/credit the invoice. Please forward the invoice to people-ops@redwood.example so we can escalate. :email:

 tom (Benefits): If the contractor plan offered COBRA, the vendor might bill until they receive FT confirmation. Well contact the TPA (AcmeBenefits) and request a reversal. If they dont reverse, payroll can apply a one-time pre-tax credit. Use payroll code: BENEF-ADJ and include vendor invoice and benefits confirmation.

 payroll-bot: Helpful link: https://payroll.redwood.example/benefits-adjust. Standard workflow: vendor credit -> benefits confirmation -> payroll adjustment (BENEF-ADJ).

 sarah: Thanks — Ive emailed the invoice to people-ops and CCd payroll. Appreciate the quick help.
